CustomField.label: Approver 2
CustomField.description:
★R9 Level 2 of the approval chain: the Level 1 approver's manager, read from User.ManagerId at submit time and frozen there.
Blank means the chain ended at level 1 — either the level 1 approver is a Regional Head (the chain stops at the first one it reaches) or they have no Manager. Blank is not an error state: the approval process's step 2 is gated on this field being populated and is skipped when it is not.
